title: Building My Tavelo Grow | From Bare Frame to Finished Bike

takeaways.text: The seatpost stopped at the seatstay junction about 3–4 cm too high for him, so he had to cut it; together with another inspection's 120 mm insertion finding, check minimum saddle height before ordering.
The frame itself gave little trouble; routing hoses down through the bar, spacers and two small holes above the headset bearing was fiddly, and he advises feeding hoses up from the calipers instead.

disclosure: The presenter says he bought this size 51.5 frame with his own money from UK dealer Wood Cycles, which he thanks in the video.
summary: Owner build of a self-bought Tavelo Grow with Shimano-compatible wireless shifting, including the seatpost fit problem.
